opportunities.title: Grinch and Kisses holiday packs, 2027
opportunities.what_is_happening: Hershey's 2026 holiday line includes co-branded Grinch packaging, a Grinch bar 6-pack, and a limited-edition Kisses gift-wrapping foil kit sold online.
opportunities.why_flowcode: Licensed holiday packs reach national shoppers but capture no first-party data from the pack itself.
opportunities.confidence_why: Brand press release, three signals; close packaging and snack match
opportunities.size_why: National holiday packaging on the flagship Hershey's brand
opportunities.timing_why: 2026 packs already printed; pitch the 2027 holiday run
opportunities.suggested_play: Flowcode on Grinch 6-pack and foil kit opens a holiday FlowHub: gifting ideas, Grinch sweepstakes, shop.hersheys.com link. FlowID captures each scanner and syncs to CRM.
opportunities.first_step: Ask the seasonal brand manager when 2027 holiday packaging artwork locks.

play.name: On-pack conversion funnel
play.play: Put a Flowcode on the pack that leads to a FlowHub (sweepstakes, recipe, game, store locator). Capture each scanner into FlowID and sync to the CRM. The code's destination can change after printing, so one print run supports later campaigns.

products.name: Flowcodes
products.page_quote: Drive conversions in the real world with the #1 Enterprise QR code.
products.what_it_does: Dynamic, branded QR codes for physical touchpoints. The destination can be changed after printing. Every code is measured on its own and by location.
products.use_when: The brand has a physical or broadcast touchpoint (pack, shelf, display, OOH, TV spot, venue signage, merch) with no measurable digital next step.

products.name: FlowHubs
products.page_quote: Deliver personalized offers, apps, promotions, and sponsor ads straight from your brand ecosystem.
products.what_it_does: Mobile landing pages and campaign hubs, built from templates or fully custom. Routes each visitor to the right offer, content or action.
products.use_when: A campaign has several destinations (sweepstakes, recipe, store locator, app, sponsor offer) and needs one branded mobile destination.

products.name: FlowID & Personalization
products.page_quote: Build a persistent first-party identity from every Flowcode, FlowURL, and FlowHub connection.
products.what_it_does: Persistent first-party identity, two-way CRM sync, Smart Rules that route by loyalty tier, LTV or audience, and Audience Builder.
products.use_when: The brand has a loyalty, rewards or CRM program, or a touchpoint that reaches people but captures no first-party data.

case_study.what_they_did: Flowcodes on snack packaging led to a 'Snap, Scan, Win' giveaway, CRM sign-up and online purchase.

opportunities.title: Creme Bars Pinky Up TV and social
opportunities.what_is_happening: Hershey's launched Creme Bars in September 2026 with KATSEYE 'Pinky Up' across national TV, CTV, paid social and influencers; sampling and pop-ups planned.
opportunities.why_flowcode: Heavy TV and creator spend with no scannable or trackable next step to attribute results.
opportunities.confidence_why: Two agreeing trade sources; close CPG TV sweepstakes match
opportunities.size_why: National TV, CTV and paid social launch
opportunities.timing_why: Launch spot produced; pitch next flight and follow-on activations
opportunities.suggested_play: Flowcode in the next CTV cut and FlowURLs in influencer posts lead to one FlowHub: KATSEYE content, sweepstakes, where-to-buy. Analytics compare network and creator performance.
opportunities.first_step: Ask the media lead which Creme Bars flights and creator posts are still being bought.

opportunities.first_step: Pitch the Reese's brand team a waitlist capture for the next Reese's Pie drop.

opportunities.title: Twizzlers CFL postseason sponsorship
opportunities.what_is_happening: Hershey Canada's Twizzlers became an official sponsor of the 2026 CFL postseason, including the Grey Cup.
opportunities.why_flowcode: Sponsorship reaches fans, but those fans stay with the league instead of becoming Twizzlers contacts.
